audit.summary: Four demonstrated core defects concern the index domain, inversion energy conversion, local-to-global avoidance and the Poincare step in C2 convergence. Eight bounded local corrections remain. Exact source only; energy quantization itself not disproved.
limitations: Negative-cone span is not Morse index — Counterevidence: Constant sequence still quantizes. Disjoint supports in Section7.3 do produce a true negative-definite span for the corrected index.

Appendix A omits inversion/end contribution — Counterevidence: No neck exists in the original constant sequence. p1 already warns that W is not invariant when the Euclidean topology changes. Main E identity survives exactly; another normalization can avoid this example.

Mean-curvature gauge cannot avoid every global image under local Willmore assumptions — Counterevidence: The global Willmore hypothesis of the principal quantization theorem excludes the inserted open spherical pieces. The direct normalization conclusion of Theorem4.1 is weaker than the exact zero-mean condition and is not itself disproved by this example.
Incorrect S3 energy identity — Counterevidence: E≤B and B=2E−2Area+4pi chi≤2E+4pi chi preserve boundedness equivalence at fixed topology.
Torus gluing twist and hyperbolic collar metric — Counterevidence: Correct rotational gluing and sine factor retain local conformal-cylinder reduction.
Time-like label contradicts the null affine limit — Counterevidence: IntroTheoremI and Remark5.14 and laterproof use the correct null type. Null-line convergence is not disproved.
Sign of inversion conformal factor — Counterevidence: Two-sided upper/lower distance bounds control reciprocal as well,so subsequent comparability need not fail.

Uncentered Poincare replacement in C2 proof — Counterevidence: Lemma'sdelta''≥delta can be recovered on interiorcylinders by differentiatingharmonicmapPDE firstinθ;w=Yθ,U=gradw really havezeroangularmean. BoundedY/smallgrad andinteriorelliptic estimates give smallcoefficients,thenlegitimatePoincare yieldsdelta''≥delta.
Normal family may cease to be immersed before t=1 — Counterevidence: Existence of realizingfamily follows forsmalltime bycompactness;timecompressionpreservesvelocity.
Ambient and covariant Dirichlet Hessian conventions mixed — Counterevidence: Removing the spuriousnonnegative term only improvesanestablishednegativeupperbound.
Area conversion misses factor two — Counterevidence: Uniformfactorcorrectionpreservesthe requirednegativesignandorder.
Missing factor in arclength chain rule — Counterevidence: ExistingrelativeestimatesW_t=o(v),Wtt=o(v²),Ytt*=o(v²)makethecorrectedterm o(1).

Restrict/track compatible target normalizations or add the signed4pi multiplicity contributions for inversions and ends.

Restore area term and Euler coefficient.

Include twist in endpoint gluing and use sin in the collar metric.

Replace time-like with light-like/null.

Change plus to minus.

Use angularly differentiated equation and zero-meanfields,not the full uncentered derivative.

Compose time withh(t)=epsilon tanh(t/epsilon),h'(0)=1.

Restorefactor2consistently.
